# Frontend Instructions (v4.0)
# Applies to: src/components/**, src/pages/**, *.tsx, *.jsx

- Use functional components with hooks (no class components)
- Prefer Tailwind utility classes when project uses Tailwind
- Co-locate component tests in __tests__/ or *.test.tsx
- Keep components under 200 lines; extract subcomponents when larger
- Use semantic HTML elements
- Test user interactions, not implementation details
- Accessibility: all interactive elements must be keyboard-navigable
